```{=html}
<iframe class="slide-deck" src="../../live/day.html" title="Slides of the day format"></iframe>
```

Open the deck [in its own tab](../../live/day.html){target="_blank"} for the full screen, the speaker view and the keyboard controls: the `d` key switches the optional runs of slides on and off, `[` and `]` jump between parts, and `g` opens a jump bar that finds a slide by its title. The cells of its hands-on slides run R inside your browser once the engine has loaded.
